title: The First Road
detail: Visit The Academy and clear your first lesson battle.
story: Professor Newton tells you the world will feel overwhelming until you choose a first road and follow it. The Academy is where that road begins.

title: Road to Physics Keep
detail: Follow the northern road and clear Physics Keep.
story: The Academy's first recommendation is simple: go north and learn the rules of motion before chasing harder disciplines.

title: A Letter from the Coast
detail: Travel east and clear Alchemy Lab.
story: Once you understand motion, the Academy sends you east. Matter and materials are the next step in seeing how the world is built.

title: Proof at the Citadel
detail: Travel south and clear Math Citadel.
story: Your mentors now insist that intuition is not enough. To keep going, you need the precise language that lets STEM become exact.

title: Design for the Real World
detail: Travel west and clear Engineers Haven.
story: When you have enough theory, the world asks for designs. Engineers Haven is where ideas become tools, structures, and systems.

title: The Grand Tour
detail: Visit every specialist town at least once.
story: A real scholar does not master only one corner of the map. The Academy wants proof that you have seen the whole world.
